notes: Accounts are named by their Delux code: 1120 cash in transit, 1160 HBL (Raast and bank transfer), 1170 JazzCash, 1180 card clearing, 1190 posting suspense, 1200 AR, 1300 inventory, 2300 tax payable, 4100 sales, 4120 sales discounts, 4210 rounding, 5100 COGS. Every case is bill C03-S000412 of branch br-main dated 2026-11-02 unless it says otherwise, with no lock date and no customer. Money in paisa, quantities in thousandths. `context` changes the default context: `lockDate`, `customer`, `methods` (merged), `withoutRoles` (removed).

cases.name: the worked example (posting rules §8): Rs 4,350 cash, cost Rs 3,100
line and bill discounts: Cr SALES at the line totals, Dr SALES_DISCOUNT the bill discount
rounded up by Rs 0.40: Cr ROUNDING; selling the last one leaves 0, which is not negative
rounded down by Rs 0.40: Dr ROUNDING
split cash + JazzCash + card: one debit per tender, each to its own account (ACC-08)
Raast and bank transfer both to HBL: one debit line for the account
cash + on account: AR carries the customer, whose ledger entry falls due after 30 days (ACC-03)
all on account, a customer without terms: due the same day
on account without a customer: not posted
1.500 m of hose at Rs 133.33 a metre: cost Rs 199.995 rounds half away from zero to Rs 200
tax at 17% (switched on later, ACC-09): Cr TAX_PAYABLE the tax total
an item never received: cost 0 and no COGS lines, flagged no_cost, and negative stock
an item with no cost on two lines: no_cost once
selling 2 with 1 on the shelf: stock goes to −1 and is flagged (INV-03, never blocked)
already below zero: no new negative_stock
the same item on two lines: the second line sees the first, and flags the crossing once
none in the shop but some in the godown: the shop goes negative and is flagged
dated before the lock date: posts the day after it, flagged posted_after_lock
dated on the lock date itself: also the day after it
dated after the lock date: its own date, no exception
Raast without an account: not posted (method_unmapped)
a chart without COGS: not posted (role_unmapped)
payments Rs 50 short of the lines (a counter bug): posted, Dr SUSPENSE Rs 50 (owner answer 3)
payments Rs 50 over the lines: posted, Cr SUSPENSE Rs 50
